name: FrescolinoGroup__pyhdf5io
behavioral_change: h5py v_old 2.10.0 to v_new 3.14.0. h5py.Dataset.__getitem__ returns bytes instead of str for variable-length string data (the UTF-8 decoding was removed; Dataset.asstr is the new explicit interface).
downstream_effect: The serialization type-tag lookup no longer matches, so the failure appears in the dispatch logic at a different line from the one where decoding must be added.
reference_fix: The reference fix adds decoding of the string read from HDF5 before the type-tag lookup.
